brief.text:
GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — all 10 starters clear and locked in, first kickoff under 3 hours away
Do now: nothing — full go across the board
Locks next 24h: 10:00 AM PT (Brown, Higgins, Flowers, Downs, Strange, Tuten, Jaguars DEF) · 1:25 PM PT (Herbert, Hampton) · 5:20 PM PT (Aubrey)
Lineup by kickoff — 10:00 AM PT: Chase Brown (RB) start, healthy. Tee Higgins (WR) start, officially off the injury report after the heel scare. Zay Flowers (WR) start — battled a hamstring issue this week too but was a full practice participant Thu/Fri and is fully clear. Josh Downs (WR) start, calf issue was "very minor," full practice all week. Brenton Strange (TE) start, no tag — but JAX's forecast has turned into a real weather flag (92°F/103° heat index, storms with 40-50mph gusts expected after the 1pm ET kickoff). Bhayshul Tuten (RB/FLEX) start — LeQuint Allen (hip) still a game-time call, doesn't change Tuten's role, same storm risk applies. Jaguars DEF start, same weather note. — 1:25 PM PT: Justin Herbert (QB) start. Omarion Hampton (RB) start — Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) fully cleared, no threat to the job. — 5:20 PM PT: Brandon Aubrey (K) start, no concerns.
Waivers / trades: Sunday run — see the Waivers/Trades tabs for Tuesday's numbers, unchanged today.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — lineup locked, Kamara's inactive designation removes the last doubt on Etienne
Do now: nothing
Locks next 24h: 10:00 AM PT (Brown, Wilson, Washington, Judkins, Etienne) · 5:20 PM PT (Pickens, Likely) — Stafford, Myers, and 49ers DEF are already final
Lineup by kickoff — Already final: Matthew Stafford (QB) 15/25, 155 yds, 1 INT in a 27-7 loss; Jason Myers (K) hit two FGs in a 13-10 win; 49ers DEF held the Rams to 7 points. — 10:00 AM PT: Chase Brown (RB) start. Garrett Wilson (WR) start, no injury tag, first game back since November. Parker Washington (WR) start, fully healthy and will also handle JAX's punt returns. Quinshon Judkins (RB/FLEX) start — still the same precautionary, minor issue Monken described, expected to play, but pair JAX's 3rd-ranked run D with real storm risk after 1pm and this is the week's shakiest floor play; no better flex on the bench, stays in. Travis Etienne Jr. (RB) start — Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) is now OFFICIALLY INACTIVE for Sunday, Etienne is the unquestioned bellcow with zero committee risk. — 5:20 PM PT: George Pickens (WR) start, no concerns. Isaiah Likely (TE) start — Malik Nabers (knee) still a game-time call for Dallas-Giants tonight; Likely's role holds either way.
Waivers / trades: Sunday run — see the Waivers/Trades tabs for Tuesday's numbers, unchanged today.

FYI: Chase Brown starts in both leagues; four Jacksonville pieces (Strange, Tuten, Jaguars DEF, Parker Washington) plus Cleveland's Judkins now carry real weather risk from afternoon storms and 40-50mph gusts forecast to hit during the 1pm ET Jaguars-Browns kickoff — could push both offenses run-heavy; Michael Wilson still sits on both benches with no injury concern.

waivers.text:
SLEEPER — TE is still the priority: you roster zero backup there, and Strange shares Week 7's JAX/LAC bye cluster with Herbert, Hampton, Tuten, and your DEF. FAAB budget is untouched at $100 (nobody in the league has spent a dollar yet) and you sit waiver position 3.
1. Darren Waller (TE, CAR) — Carolina's TE2 on the depth chart behind Tommy Tremble but the far more proven player with real path to the job. Drop Fernando Mendoza (your QB3, confirmed as Vegas' backup behind Kirk Cousins — zero standalone value). FAAB $9.
2. Samaje Perine (RB, CIN) — the direct backup to Chase Brown, who anchors your RB1 slot in BOTH leagues; this is bye-week and injury insurance you don't currently have anywhere on either roster. Drop Zachariah Branch (WR, no role in ATL). FAAB $7.
3. Justice Hill (RB, BAL) — locked in as Derrick Henry's clear #2 and the passing-down back in a full-PPR league; real standalone flex value. Drop Zavion Thomas (WR, no role in CHI). FAAB $6.
4. AJ Barner (TE, SEA) — second TE flier if you miss on Waller or want a true pair. Drop Michael Wilson (WR, buried behind Marvin Harrison Jr./Trey McBride in the ARI target mix, no path to a role). FAAB $4.
5. Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI) — cheap speculative stash in a muddled Bears backfield. Only add if you're willing to also cut Woody Marks or Stefon Diggs — your 6 bench spots are full once picks 1-4 land. FAAB $3.
No DEF/K stream needed this week — Aubrey and the Jaguars D&ST both carry plus Week 1 matchups per the Analysis tab.

YAHOO — still no access to the Yahoo free-agent pool this run (private league, no login, screenshots only). Isaiah Likely being confirmed healthy lowers urgency at TE, but Chig Okonkwo remains a thin TE2 if you want a stopgap plan. Drop a fresh screenshot of the free-agent list (Players > Available, filtered by position) into the War room Drive folder and next run can give you real availability and bid guidance.

trades.text:
SLEEPER — send Stefon Diggs to Grandmasterfabe ("Master Bate$ LaPortapotty") for Jake Ferguson (TE, DAL). Diggs is stuck behind Higgins, Flowers, and Downs on your bench with no path to starting reps; Grandmasterfabe is stacked at WR (Olave, DeVonta Smith, Jameson Williams, Jakobi Meyers, Alec Pierce) but is rolling with rookie Harold Fannin as their only real TE, with Ferguson buried as insurance. Diggs gives them a proven bye-week/injury-fill starter; you turn a fully blocked bench piece into the backup TE you currently have nowhere on the roster, which matters with Strange sharing the Week 7 JAX/LAC bye cluster. It's a mild overpay in raw value on your side, justified by how scarce TE depth is around this league right now — nobody scanned so far is sitting on two startable options. Checked your Weeks 15-17 outlook first: Diggs isn't projected to be a playoff starter behind your current WR corps, so moving him costs you nothing down the stretch.

YAHOO — no trade idea this run. I don't have visibility into other managers' rosters or trade blocks in your private Yahoo league (screenshots only cover your team and this week's opponent), so I can't responsibly name a real deal. No trade.txt found in the War room folder either.

news.headline: Tee Higgins Injury Update: What's the Latest on the Bengals Star and Will He Play in Week 1?
news.summary: Higgins missed a midweek practice with a heel contusion but is fully off the injury report and cleared to play Sunday against Tampa Bay.

news.headline: Jaguars' LeQuint Allen: Questionable for Sunday's game
news.summary: Allen was limited in Friday's practice and remains a game-time decision on a hip injury; his absence would grow Bhayshul Tuten's workload.

news.headline: Will Alvin Kamara play in Saints vs. Lions? Latest injury report on RB
news.summary: Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) has been ruled out for Sunday's opener at Detroit, leaving Travis Etienne Jr. as the Saints' unchallenged workhorse back.

news.headline: Chargers vs. Cardinals Injury Report: Keaton Mitchell, Tuli Tuipulotu limited to start Week 1
news.summary: Mitchell (hamstring) is now fully cleared off the injury report and good to go, though he was never a threat to Omarion Hampton's role.

news.headline: Week 1 Injury Report | Buccaneers vs Bengals
news.summary: Perine isn't listed on Cincinnati's final injury report and remains Chase Brown's clear backup with no health concerns of his own.

news.headline: Zay Flowers upgraded on Ravens' Week 1 injury report
news.summary: Flowers battled a hamstring injury through the week but was a full practice participant Thursday and Friday and is off the injury report entirely for Sunday's opener at Indianapolis.

news.headline: Colts news: Josh Downs downplays calf injury with 'very minor' assurance
news.summary: Downs practiced fully all week and isn't on the injury report; he called the training-camp calf issue very minor.

news.headline: 5 Things We Learned About the Jaguars This Week: Parker Washington's Situation
news.summary: Washington is fully healthy after missing preseason time with an undisclosed injury and will also handle punt returns to start the season.

news.headline: Todd Monken: Quinshon Judkins dealing with nagging injury, out as a precaution
news.summary: Judkins missed midweek practice with what head coach Todd Monken called a precautionary, nagging injury, and is not expected to miss Sunday's opener.

news.headline: 3 reasons Jets fans should be salivating over Garrett Wilson's impending return vs. Titans
news.summary: Wilson carries no injury designation and is set to play his first game since November 2025.

news.headline: Injury Report: Statuses for Giants vs. Cowboys on Sunday Night Football
news.summary: Nabers (knee) was a full practice participant Friday but is officially questionable and expected to be a game-time call for tonight's opener against Dallas.

news.headline: Commanders vs. Eagles Week 1 injury report
news.summary: Okonkwo enters Washington's top tight end job in Week 1 and isn't carrying any injury designation of his own on the final report.

news.headline: Rams vs. 49ers takeaways: Matthew Stafford pulled late in blowout loss for L.A.
news.summary: Stafford finished 15-of-25 for just 155 yards with an interception and no touchdowns as San Francisco's defense throttled the Rams 27-7 in the season opener in Melbourne.

news.headline: 49ers Open 2026 With 27-7 Win Over Rams in Melbourne; Takeaways from #SFvsLAR
news.summary: San Francisco's defense held the Rams to 7 points, intercepted Stafford, and recovered a Fred Warner-forced fumble in a dominant season-opening win.

news.headline: NFL Kickoff 2026: Seahawks beat Patriots 13-10, but lose Sam Darnold to hip injury
news.summary: Myers hit field goals of 26 and 30 yards as Seattle held on for a 13-10 win over New England after starter Sam Darnold left early with a hip injury.
